rationale: Price remains decisively below both the 5-min VWAP ($11.11) and session VWAP ($11.29), confirming ongoing seller control consistent with the original thesis; the minor bounce from the $10.87 low shows no meaningful volume conviction and has not reclaimed the invalidation level at $11.05. The 9-EMA has drifted down to current price ($10.91), which narrows the buffer to invalidation but does not negate the trade — a flat/compressing EMA in this context reflects price in equilibrium rather than a bullish reclaim. With 220 minutes remaining and the target at $10.50 still well within the day's established range, there is sufficient time for the setup to develop without forced action.
